name: fresh-tracker-error-replay-acquisition-v1
purpose: Prospective development evaluation of strong deterministic ledger versus frozen ArbiterKB on fresh visual tracker errors.

source.method: new fixed-camera RGB-D recordings; independently staged after this manifest is frozen
source.selection: record every planned episode in ID order; do not retain or reject based on tracker or memory outcome
source.stage_a_use: pipeline and annotation validation only; never part of the scored comparison
source.stage_b_use: prospective development comparison only; not held-out test evidence

scene.objects: three visually identical opaque containers, one target item, one distractor item, and a fixed legal-pick menu
scene.camera: one fixed, calibrated RGB-D task camera at 10 Hz or faster; aligned RGB/depth, intrinsics, extrinsics, timestamps, and no auto-reframing
scene.ground_truth_camera: optional independent overhead camera or concealed identity marker stream; never exposed to detector, tracker, ledger, or ArbiterKB
scene.viewpoint_schedule: two preregistered fixed task-camera poses, alternated by episode ID parity
scene.label: controlled scenarios with naturally occurring tracker errors

recording.episode_structure: identity initialization, scripted occlusion/swap, reappearance, then exactly two identity-critical legal-pick decision points
recording.operator_script: fixed trajectory cards chosen from the scenario stratum before recording; no adaptive restaging after tracker inspection
recording.raw_data_rule: write-once; SHA-256 every stream immediately after capture

perception.pipeline: frozen stress/perceive.py GroundingDINO -> SAM -> Cutie adapter
perception.required_runtime: pinned sg_pilot environment and model weights recorded by content hash
perception.vocabulary: open, task-derived vocabulary only; no simulator scene counts, colours, object IDs, oracle poses, or future frames
perception.threshold_rule: all detector, mask, tracker, relink, and occlusion thresholds frozen after Stage A and before any Stage B memory comparison
perception.common_stream: one serialized observation trace per episode is supplied byte-identically to both memory arms

annotation.identity_source: independent ground-truth stream or concealed markers not visible in task-camera RGB
annotation.procedure: two annotators independently label object identity at every decision and on both sides of each occlusion/pass; disagreements are adjudicated without memory outputs
annotation.blindness: annotators may see raw recordings and tracker output for error taxonomy, but never ledger/Arbiter comparative outcomes
annotation.quality_gate: 100% agreement after adjudication at decision points and >=0.95 pre-adjudication identity agreement
annotation.leakage_rule: ground truth is joined only after both memory states and legal actions are serialized

exclusions.timing: technical exclusions are signed before comparative scoring

separation_and_leakage.duplicate_check: SHA-256 exact match plus perceptual video hash against all allowed historical development media before processing
separation_and_leakage.development_test_policy: this 30-episode batch is development evidence; any later test set requires a new sealed manifest and independent recordings

memory_and_decision.decision_rule: existing canonical legal-pick projection: choose the visible legal target with highest identity mass; deterministic stable menu-order tie break; no abstain, verify, or re-observe action
pre_score_fixtures: identical canonical states produce identical actions
arm label alone cannot alter an action
a valid probability ordering change can alter a legal pick
memory_and_decision.primary_outcome: episode-clustered paired correct-target legal-action rate over all eligible decision points
memory_and_decision.multiplicity: primary outcome unadjusted; Holm adjustment across the frozen secondary hypothesis family

size_and_gate.precision_note: with discordance 0.30, 30 episodes gives an approximate 95% half-width of 0.196 for an episode-level paired difference; about 116 episodes are needed for 0.10 half-width under that variance assumption, and 385 under the worst case
size_and_gate.stage_a_pass: all required streams valid, tracker runs on 6/6, annotations pass, zero leakage, and at least one naturally produced association or occlusion-recovery error is measurable
size_and_gate.stage_b_stop: preserve every episode; stop only for the fixed cost/safety gate or a systematic pipeline defect that invalidates all comparisons

hash_rule: manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON after removing the manifest_sha256 field
